annotations.title: Signet pledge pool — terms and entry list (read-only)

description: Read one pledge pool: its stake token (mint), stake size, lock time, release deadline, phase (open | locked | released), the organiser's meta (for a contest, its rules) and every pledge with its status, deposit address, payout address, memo and reference. Public; no login needed. A pledge pool is how a contest holds stakes: pledgers may cancel until it locks, then each pledge is either BURNED or RELEASED by the organiser, and anything undecided at the deadline is released automatically.
